remediation_matrix.title: Compose external postgres_data volume
remediation_matrix.evidence: docker-compose.yml lines 311-314 declare volume postgres_data as external: true, causing docker compose up to crash on clean checkouts.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Remove external: true and retain name: medmatch_postgres_data.

remediation_matrix.title: Missing Compose healthcheck for AI service & worker
remediation_matrix.evidence: ai-service lacks healthcheck in compose and frontend uses condition: service_started, risking 502 errors during Uvicorn startup. Worker has no HTTP server and no dependents, so Compose worker healthcheck is unnecessary.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Add Python urllib healthcheck on /api/health/ready to ai-service in docker-compose.yml; update frontend dependency condition to service_healthy. Narrow scope to exclude worker from Compose healthcheck.

remediation_matrix.title: Redundant HuggingFace cache in runtime image
remediation_matrix.evidence: Model path is NOT broken; application successfully loads from /app/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2. However, Stage 1 downloads ~100MB to /opt/huggingface and Stage 2 copies it into runtime, where it is 100% unused dead weight.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Remove Stage 1 HuggingFace remote model download and Stage 2 COPY /opt/huggingface in ai-service.Dockerfile and worker.Dockerfile.

remediation_matrix.title: Missing Kubernetes AI startupProbe
remediation_matrix.evidence: Liveness probe terminates AI pod if startup exceeds 75s. Under CPU throttling (100m request) or cold storage, initialization approaches this limit. No startupProbe exists.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Add startupProbe to infra/kubernetes/ai-service/deployment.yaml targeting /api/health/live with 150s grace window (30 retries * 5s).

remediation_matrix.title: Redundant Celery worker Dockerfile
remediation_matrix.evidence: worker.Dockerfile duplicates 80% of ai-service.Dockerfile. Both share 100% of dependencies and UID 1000. In Kubernetes, the worker deployment already overrides the container command to celery.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Consolidate worker build onto ai-service.Dockerfile in compose and manifests.

remediation_matrix.title: Mutable image tags in production manifests
remediation_matrix.evidence: Manifests reference :latest and :phase2-migrations with imagePullPolicy: Always. Changing these tags in manifests without a corresponding CI/CD registry push will break image pulls.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Defer to CI/CD release engineering phase when automated image building and semver tagging are established.

remediation_matrix.title: pytest in production image
remediation_matrix.evidence: pytest and pytest-mock are declared in services/ai-service/requirements.txt and installed into the runtime virtualenv.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: Move pytest and pytest-mock to requirements-dev.txt.

remediation_matrix.title: Worker root initContainer (UID 0)
remediation_matrix.evidence: Worker init-uploads runs as UID 0 to chmod 777 /app/uploads for PVC volume mounting. Remediating volume ownership is tightly coupled to PVC storage class design in Phase 13.4.

remediation_matrix.title: Subdirectory .dockerignore ignored in root-context builds
remediation_matrix.evidence: Docker BuildKit only parses root .dockerignore for root-context builds. Root .dockerignore is already comprehensive.
remediation_matrix.recommended_fix: No code remediation required. Document authoritative role of root .dockerignore.

remediation_matrix.title: Worker Celery inspect ping probe blocking
remediation_matrix.evidence: Solo worker pool blocks inspect ping during long synchronous PDF processing tasks. Probe redesign is fundamentally linked to worker pool architecture in Phase 13.4.
